proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord attunement restriction metadata
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item record can only express a boolean attunement requirement, so it loses the class-gated eligibility on items that require attunement by specific classes.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Staff, Rare (Requires Attunement by a Bard, Cleric, or Druid)

notes: The charge-based casting, dawn recharge, and last-charge destruction all fit the current surface and traced cleanly. The encoded JSON necessarily omits the bard/cleric/druid attunement restriction because the record shape only supports requiresAttunement: boolean.
